summary: The note describes Maria, a 1995 album by Canadian singer and songwriter Jane Siberry, which received critical acclaim. It is notable as her first album without musical contributions from longtime collaborators Ken Myhr, John Switzer and Rebecca Jenkins.
one_line: Maria is a 1995 critically acclaimed album by Canadian singer-songwriter Jane Siberry, her first without longtime collaborators.
